title: Nashville Family Lake House on Old Hickory Lake
description:
There's nothing like having a cup of coffee and watching the sun rise on one of the decks of my lake home.  We designed it to be peaceful and accommodating, and I believe we've done just that.  In the summer, Two Foot Cove is the place to be.  Most families love spending the weekends here, especially since you're 20 minutes from the neon of downtown Nashville.  The very bottom floor is an efficiency space that I frequent from April through October.
No one over 200lbs on bunk beds😊

The space
We kept the design light and airy, with a beautiful wide-open living room.  You can enjoy the outdoors even indoors with multiple windows, and look down on thewater on 2 deck levels.
New corn hole game, can be found on the downstairs porch or in the shed with the fishing gear.

Guest access
You have access to the 2nd and 3rd floors of the house.  The bottom floor is an efficiency space that my family and I frequent in the summer months.
